instruction: Patch only Fresh transcript locator semantics/tests/docs and publish turn-010 immutable review evidence. First, make every visible transcript-shaped node carrying data-message-author-role participate in ordering: user/assistant keep their roles, while any other non-empty explicit role such as tool/system becomes unknown and therefore an intervening barrier; structural fallback must likewise not silently omit an explicit unknown author role. Second, make editable exclusion honor effective editability, including node.isContentEditable, contenteditable with empty/true/plaintext-only forms, INPUT/TEXTAREA and role=textbox, so their descendants and containers cannot prove a transcript turn. Add deterministic tests for user -> data-message-author-role=tool/system -> completed assistant yielding no association/result; exact wire inside contenteditable="", contenteditable="plaintext-only" and an inherited editable ancestor yielding no user match; a normal transcript sibling still matching; duplicated REQUEST_ID/CONTROL_ID/NONCE labels inside one candidate yielding no match; and two distinct exact full-wire users remaining ambiguous. Assert zero click/send/result on all negatives. Run full Python/Node/syntax/manifest/diff gates, preserve version/protocol/build and unrelated authority, and publish the bounded turn-010 review authority. Do not start any post-turn10 or turn11 work.
codex_action: Made explicit unknown author roles transcript barriers; honored effective editability; added deterministic no-send/no-result negative cases and retained normal sibling matching. Published finite reviewer-directed source/tests/protocol correction after full offline regression.
